function: Device activity detection for grant-free massive access at a multi-antenna BS, with IRS-aided and direct-link devices of unknown, mixed fading types (pp. 1-2).
system: Single-cell uplink: BS with M=32 antennas; reflecting IRS with N=40 elements serving blocked devices; K=100 potential devices, signature length L=20; frequency band not stated (pp. 2, 4).
method: Deep unfolding of projected gradient descent (trainable step sizes, linear layers approximating covariance inverse) with MLP gating network selecting one of three experts; supervised incremental end-to-end training (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Rician (10 dB) or Rayleigh direct links, Rician device-IRS and IRS-BS links, path loss -60-22log10(distance product) dB, 3D device geometry (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training data not described; tests at Rician factors 10 dB, noise -95 dBm, groups 40/30/30% (Fig. 3) and K1 share 0-80% (Fig. 4); M=32, N=40, K=100, L=20 (p. 4).
baselines: Learned: deep unfolding detectors [19] and [20], transformer-based detector [21]. Non-learned: covariance-based coordinate descent, PGD with and without grouping information (pp. 4-5).
metrics: Missed-detection versus false-alarm probability curves, error probability at PF=PM versus share of IRS-aided devices, and inference latency in ms (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Order O(LM + I(M^3+LM)) with MoE versus O(I(M^3+LM)) without; inference latency about 64-77 ms for the proposed method (Fig. 5) (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 2: "devices in K2 following Rician fading and those in K3 following Rayleigh fading"; p. 4: βk "generated according to βk = −60 − 22 log10 (λk λ0) in dB". Custom simulator; no standardized model or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "Fig. 4 illustrates the flexibility and generalization ability ... with the proportion of devices in K1 varies from 0% to 80%", but the training data are never described, so testing outside the training conditions is not stated.
q3_support: p. 4: "compare ... with two deep unfolding baselines [19], [20], traditional coordinate descent (CD) algorithm ..., the derived PGD algorithm and a transformer-based detector [21]"; all appear in the PM-PF curves of Fig. 3.
q4_support: p. 4: "with the MoE module, the computational complexity becomes O(LM + I · (M3 + LM))"; p. 5: "computation times of different deep learning methods" (Fig. 5, latency in ms).
q5_support: p. 4: "The large-scale coefficient of each device βk is generated according to" a path-loss formula: simulated channels only; no code or data link and no public channel dataset.
notes: Area 1 is a judgment call for the reviewer: the learned method detects device activity (binary on-off detection of each device from the received signal at a 32-antenna BS), with missed-detection and false-alarm probabilities as the main metric, which I matched to MIMO detection; if area 1 is read strictly as data-symbol detection, the reason would be 'function' (p. 1). q2 is borderline: Fig. 4 claims 'generalization ability' over K1 proportions, but the gating network is trained against the true group proportions (Eq. 12, p. 4), so varied proportions were likely in training; marked 0. Fig. 5 latency values are read from the bar chart (p. 5).
